prediction.description: A yellow/brassy/golden long-tailed comet ('hairy star', 'bearded light', 'broom of fire', 'fiery sword') should appear low in the west / above the sunset and shine for about ten to twelve nights, around 658 (give or take 2).

summary: A yellowish comet seen in the west for 10-12 nights returns roughly every 32 years (435, 468, 502, 534, 562, 597, 626).

prediction.description: Wugoutour (called Thetynd by the Skebrae chroniclers) should be abandoned, its people scattering to the hills, two years after the 633 sea-breach.

summary: A sea storm smashing the boats at Laramirn (= Emdrond) is followed one year later by the sea breaking the dikes at Wugoutour (= Thetynd), and two years after that Wugoutour/Thetynd is abandoned (441-442-444, 525-526-528, 632-633-[635]).

prediction.description: A great fire should burn the town of Hawoumia (called Mynyzael at Skebrae), one year after the 634 drought at Stuweisko.

summary: A summer-long drought (at Stuweisko = Aenkov) is followed one year later by a fire at Hawoumia (= Mynyzael): 442->443, 533->534, 595->596 (wells of Hawoumia ran dry), 634->[635].
